reviewLimits: Production review of current source-bound image bytes, not Amazon eligibility or independent proof of private authorization. Primary hierarchy reviewed at 200px; fine labels/specification text use full image. Representative accessory styling was explicitly approved by user; exact accessory SKU is not claimed.

images.notes: B01/BG01 blue-white direction matches approved preview. One primary integration/desk-organization benefit, accurate sourced angle, classic inputs, no Windows treatment or CPU/capacity/display table. Logo in measured top-right negative space. Primary headline readable at 200px; fine copy at full size. Primary fact IDs: aio.integration. Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

Original synthetic empty office plate, no people or extra devices. Official angle set placed on desk, computer/keyboard/mouse complete. Scene-oriented copy without paid app/meeting/throughput claims. Blue-white family and OEM logo visible at 200px; no configuration recap. Primary fact IDs: . Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

Sole complete base configuration page. Actual ERP VA-215 -> PA-222 identifies i5-14500T, Intel Integrated Graphics, 8GB DDR5, 256GB Gen4 SSD and Windows 11 Pro. Values individually inspected for spelling and clipping at large view; enlarged capacity type after first review. No optional tiers; primary page identity and capacities distinguishable in 200px overview, small label/detail reading uses full image. Primary fact IDs: cpu.identity, gpu.identity, ram.installed, ssd.installed, os.sold. Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

Display owner: 23.8-inch FHD, 1920x1080, 60Hz, non-touch matches ERP PA-222 and official model page. Front exact-product hardware and classic inputs unaltered. Display facts do not recur in PT03. Full-size type checked; 200px headline/product clear. Primary fact IDs: display.size, display.resolution, display.refresh, display.nonTouch. Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

Original plan -> create -> review workflow graphic, with unaltered sourced product set. No brand software UI, subscription, compatibility, performance number, configuration grid or warranty claim. Abstract task sequence is distinct from PT02 room scene; reviewed manually, no numeric fact-overlap invented. Primary fact IDs: . Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

White-background source crop of official classic black full-size keyboard and mouse. Removed stand-edge remnant from earlier crop; no keys were generated or redrawn. Full-size keyboard/number pad visually supported, wireless input supported by exact VA-215 comment. Specific accessory SKU remains unspecified under explicit user representative-treatment approval. Primary fact IDs: input.fullSizeKeyboard, input.numberPad, input.wireless, input.mouse. Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

Pop-up camera is the unique remaining hardware value, sourced directly from official QC24251 front photograph. Original physical camera module, bezel/stand/marks preserved; camera crop uses same blue LCD treatment. No camera resolution, biometric/privacy certification or warranty assertion. Classic input devices remain visible in full product view. Primary fact IDs: camera.popUp. Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.

Physical port closeups are direct official rear/right/left/below-display crops, preserving connector type/count/orientation. Leaders inspected: DP at actual DP opening, group of four rear USB-A anchored to actual first USB, RJ45 at actual jack. Separate sourced right USB-A, left headset jack, below-display USB-C/SD details shown. Wi-Fi/Bluetooth confirmed by ERP, no inferred generation. Product/input full set omitted only for permitted port detail crop. Small connector labels read at full size. Primary fact IDs: ports.displayPort, ports.rearUsbA4, ports.rj45, ports.rightUsbA, ports.headset, ports.usbC, ports.sd, wireless.wifi, wireless.bluetooth. Hardware and required keyboard/mouse as background product context are not repeated marketing claims.
